events.title: Irving Berlin's Holiday Inn
events.blurb: The Broadway song-and-dance musical opens Black Friday, playing in rotating repertory with A Christmas Carol through New Year's.
events.blurbEs: El musical de Broadway de canto y baile se estrena el Black Friday y se presenta en repertorio rotativo con A Christmas Carol hasta Año Nuevo.

events.title: So Fetch: The ULTIMATE 2000's Dance Party!
events.blurb: A 2000s throwback dance party with the floor cleared for dancing. Doors at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Una fiesta de baile con éxitos de los 2000 y la pista libre para bailar. Puertas a las 7 p.m.

events.title: 8 Ohms Band w/ The G Method (Matinee)
events.blurb: An afternoon show with the 8 Ohms Band and The G Method. Doors at 11:30 a.m.; all ages with a parent or guardian.
events.blurbEs: Un concierto de tarde con 8 Ohms Band y The G Method. Puertas a las 11:30 a.m.; todas las edades con un padre o tutor.

events.title: Nicole Atkins w/ John Gallagher Jr. & Callum
events.blurb: The soulful singer-songwriter plays the intimate supper-club room, with Tony winner John Gallagher Jr. opening. Doors at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La cantautora de voz soul se presenta en esta sala íntima, con John Gallagher Jr., ganador del Tony, como telonero. Puertas a las 7 p.m.

events.title: A Tribute to John Lodge - An Evening of Moody Blues Magic
events.blurb: Moody Blues songs performed by John's 10,000 Light Years Band, featuring Jon Davison of YES. Doors at 6 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Canciones de los Moody Blues interpretadas por John's 10,000 Light Years Band, con Jon Davison de YES. Puertas a las 6 p.m.

events.title: Grand Illumination
events.blurb: Downtown Annapolis lights its Christmas tree near the Market House and City Dock to open the holiday season.
events.blurbEs: El centro de Annapolis enciende su árbol de Navidad junto al Market House y City Dock para abrir la temporada navideña.

events.title: Lights on the Bay
events.blurb: A two-mile drive-through of more than 70 animated light displays along the Chesapeake Bay, running through January 3.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido en auto de dos millas con más de 70 espectáculos de luces animadas junto a la bahía de Chesapeake, hasta el 3 de enero.

events.title: U.S. Naval Academy Museum
events.blurb: Ship models, flags and naval history in Preble Hall on the Academy grounds. Visitors 18 and up need a valid photo ID.
events.blurbEs: Maquetas de barcos, banderas e historia naval en Preble Hall, dentro de la Academia. Los visitantes mayores de 18 años necesitan identificación con foto.
events.getThere: Unless you hold a DoD credential, park outside the Academy and walk in through Gate 1.

events.title: Banneker-Douglass-Tubman Museum
events.blurb: Maryland's official museum of African American history and culture, a short walk from the State House.
events.blurbEs: El museo oficial de historia y cultura afroamericana de Maryland, a pocos pasos del State House.
